Name: Claude Tasks
Author: James Schuler
Description: Live status of your Claude Code and Cowork sessions on Stream Deck keys. Blue = working, orange = needs input, green = done. Press a key to jump to that session.

Actions.Name: New Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Starts a new Claude conversation. Settings choose Chat, Cowork, or Code, with an optional pre-filled prompt.

Actions.Name: Chat Shortcut
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a pinned Claude chat, Code tab, or Cowork session. Works for regular claude.ai chats too (paste the chat link).

Actions.Name: Session Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the live status of one Claude Code or Cowork session. Press to open it.
